column1: - Enter your draft site and scoring setting to customize your draft sheets on the next tab
- If you'd like to make any edits, please make sure to make a copy (File - Make a copy)
- Type any number in the cell left of a player to highlight yellow (Targets)
- Type an "x" in the cell left of any player to highlight black (Drafted players)
- Each position is sorted by projection, highest to lowest
- ADP: The draft room ranking for this player positionally
- PROJ: The projected total points for this player
- VALUE: The value of this player comparing projection rank to the draft room rank
- % PROJ: Percentage of points this player is projected compared to the highest in that position
